info.title: SourceIt API
info.description: Generated from packages/shared/src/zod — not hand-written. See docs/PROJECT_STATE.md for what is and isn't implemented yet.

get.summary: The current authenticated account and its role-specific profile ids
Public publisher profile (PublisherProfileCard.tsx)
Aggregate counts for the publisher dashboard (AnalyticsCards.tsx)

403.description: Not a member of this publisher

get.summary: Recent activity feed (RecentActivity.tsx)
This publisher's articles, current version only (MyArticlesTable.tsx)
Reviews and disputes against this publisher's articles (ReviewsDisputes.tsx)
Published credibility breakdown (CredibilityPanel.tsx)
Credibility score trend (CredibilityPanel.tsx:84 sparkline)
Publisher verification queue (resolves OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #8)

post.summary: Approve or reject a publisher's verification (resolves OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #6a, #8)
Apply to become a reviewer (RegisterForm.tsx role=reviewer)

get.summary: Reviewer approval queue (resolves OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #8)

post.summary: Approve or reject a reviewer application
Create an article and its v1.0 version (PublishArticlePanel.tsx)

403.description: Not a member of the target publisher, or publisher not verified

get.summary: Article + its current version (public, unauthenticated)
Full version history — public and unauthenticated like verification itself (resolves OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #12)

post.summary: Submit a correction/update as a new version

403.description: Not a member of the owning publisher

get.summary: One version's full detail, for diffing against another (ArticleEditHistory.tsx)

patch.summary: Edit a draft version's content — draft only; append-only once submitted (resolves OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #9)

409.description: Version is no longer a draft

delete.summary: Hard-delete a draft version — draft only (resolves OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #9)

409.description: Version is no longer a draft

post.summary: Archive an article at any lifecycle stage (resolves OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #9)

get.summary: The core verification endpoint — public, unauthenticated, must never be slow or down (build prompt, Scale)

404.description: Not registered — trustStatus is always 'notfound' here, never absent

get.summary: Evidence attached to this version (EvidenceSection.tsx)

post.summary: Attach evidence to a draft version (MediaEvidenceUpload.tsx)

409.description: Version is no longer a draft — evidence binds at submission and is then append-only

get.summary: Reviews attached to this version (ReviewerNotes.tsx)

post.summary: Attach a review — 403 if the reviewer is structurally affiliated with the publisher (resolves OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #4)

403.description: Reviewer is affiliated with this publisher, or not an approved reviewer

post.summary: Retract own review — original text stays visible and intact (build prompt invariant)

403.description: Not the reviewer who wrote it

get.summary: Disputes filed against this version — always visible, never suppressible (build prompt invariant)

403.description: Reviewer is affiliated with this publisher, or not an approved reviewer

get.summary: One dispute with its full event history

post.summary: Publisher response: free text, a correction (new ArticleVersion), or both — never deletion or suppression (resolves OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #2)

403.description: Not a member of the disputed publisher

post.summary: Filer withdraws, or filer/admin marks resolved — never the publisher; SourceIt does not adjudicate truth, so this is procedural, not a verdict (build prompt invariant)

403.description: Not the filer and not an admin

get.summary: The tombstone for this version, if redacted — public (resolves OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #5)

post.summary: Redact a version under legal takedown — admin only, redaction not deletion (build prompt invariant)

get.summary: The anchor state for this version — always present, always one of pending/anchored/anchor_failed (resolves OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #1)

404.description: Version does not exist or is still a draft (no anchor record yet)

get.summary: The current reader's saved articles (SavedArticles.tsx)

delete.summary: Unbookmark — never affects the underlying article

get.summary: The current reader's followed publishers (TrustedPublishers.tsx)
